title: Negotiation
description: negotiation/v1 — the document a negotiation event carries. One event type covers a whole conversation about a report: each event is one round in a thread, and `action` says what the round does. Folding the rounds in log order yields the thread's status (open, agreed, rejected, withdrawn); nothing executes until a thread reaches FULL agreement, and a partial agreement is a counter rather than a commitment.

line.description: One asset line of a proposal.

reportId.description: The report being negotiated. The event also references the authoring margin-report event.

negotiationId.description: The thread. Several threads may run on one report as competing alternatives; agreement picks the winner.

kind.description: fulfillment = how the obligation will be met; substitution = swapping already-posted collateral. A substitution report's threads negotiate the substitution kind only.

round.description: 1 on the opening offer. A response must cite the thread's standing round; a stale round is recorded but changes no state.

action.description: offer opens the thread; counter supersedes the standing proposal and is itself a proposal; agree closes it and makes the standing lines binding; reject closes it; withdraw is the OPENER retracting their own open thread — the one response action not reserved to the counterparty.

lines.description: The proposal. Carried by offer and counter; agree, reject and withdraw carry none, since the standing round's lines are what an agreement binds.

intentId.description: The DVP intent created by the offering side after full agreement. Substitution threads only.

by.description: The emitting ORGANIZATION. Agreement events carry a role rather than an org, so authority checks and the read model rely on this field.
